listing.name: NHL Legacy Edition — furqanagwan NHL Recomp (furqanagwan)
listing.summary: Upstream reports part of a Montreal-at-Toronto match at 60 FPS and 4K on an RTX 5080 laptop in a GDK build. A full match, save/load, title updates, AMD/Intel graphics and the standard non-GDK build remain unconfirmed. Use the ROV renderer; the RTV path produces black 3D output. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA/Europe Xbox 360 files with English, French, German, Swedish, Finnish, Russian or Czech content: title ID 454109EC, media ID 3CF2A23F, default.xex version 0.0.0.4 built 2015-07-17, SHA-256 d818eb15775c1fee34b057b0fc494b211535d07123230ee45bd7d40991c55624. Use an ISO or complete extracted files with no title update.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the source configuration and build instructions with furqanagwan/rexglue-sdk. No public release is confirmed. The described setup uses Windows 11 x64 and Direct3D 12; upstream testing covers NVIDIA hardware.

warnings: Upstream reports part of a Montreal-at-Toronto match at 60 FPS and 4K on an RTX 5080 laptop in a GDK build. A full match, save/load, title updates, AMD/Intel graphics and the standard non-GDK build remain unconfirmed. Use the ROV renderer; the RTV path produces black 3D output.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
